COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
16.10.2025 C528 No.1843 of 2025
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
This application has been filed for 
quashing the entire proceedings of Criminal
Case No. 2023 of 2023, “ State vs. Kamla 
Latwal” pending before the court of 
Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Haldwani
District Nainital under Section 384 of the 
Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2. Heard Mr. Neeraj Parihar, learned 
counsel (through video conferencing) holding 
brief of Mr. Karan Singh Dugtal, learned 
counsel for the applicant and Mr. Pratiroop 
Pandey, learned Assistant Government for 
the respondent.
3. Mr. Pratiroop Pandey, learned Assistant 
Government has sought three weeks’ time to 
file counter affidavit in the present fresh 
matter.
4. Time is granted.
5. List on 24.11.2025.
(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 16.10.2025
